_note: Which S3 error codes read as a lost condition (a stale write), for both hosts' is_condition_lost / isConditionLost. code is the error's Code (python) and name (typescript); a bodiless reply carries its status as the code. 412 means the object changed since the version sent, 409 ConditionalRequestConflict that another conditional write is in flight; any other 409 or 412 keeps its own meaning.
_matched_note: Which 404s on a request carrying If-Match read as a lost condition: AWS answers 404 for a key deleted since the version was read, so any 404 about the key is lost, whatever its code; a missing bucket is not about the key, and keeps its own meaning.
